title: Business Trip
one_paragraph_synopsis: Michael embarks on an international business trip to Canada, experiencing business class amenities and exploring local dining with colleagues. Meanwhile, Pam reveals she is failing her course and must extend her stay in New York, causing concern among her coworkers. Andy faces social and relationship tensions, including a confrontation with Angela about their intimacy. Back in Scranton, Kelly and Ryan navigate their complicated relationship, breaking up and then reconciling. Michael ultimately expresses disappointment about the trip to David Wallace, while Pam returns to reunite with Jim.
